summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that all briefs have been submitted and oral argument has been scheduled for June 25, 2026 in its Federal District Court litigation in Alaska seeking to vacate an EPA veto. The filing describes a procedural court date update rather than a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No financial terms, deal mechanics, or board recommendations are provided. The registrant is the company itself reporting litigation progress. As a foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K updating legal proceedings.
